def decode_blob(blob):
    return zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(blob.encode('ascii')))


def detect_code_dir():
    start = Path.cwd().resolve()
    candidates = [
        start / 'code',
        start,
        start.parent / 'code',
        Path('/workspace/code'),
        Path('/workspace'),
        Path('/data/projects/hok1v1/code'),
        Path('/data/projects/hok1v1'),
    ]
    seen = set()
    for candidate in candidates:
        candidate = candidate.resolve() if candidate.exists() else candidate
        if candidate in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(candidate)
        if (candidate / 'agent_ppo').exists() or (candidate / 'train_test.py').exists():
            return candidate
        if candidate == start and candidate.name == 'code':
            return candidate
    return start


def backup_existing(code_dir, rel_paths):
    stamp = time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    backup_dir = code_dir / f'.r5_6_2_backup_{stamp}'
    backed_up = 0
    for rel in rel_paths:
        target = code_dir / rel
        if not target.exists():
            continue
        backup_target = backup_dir / rel
        backup_target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(target, backup_target)
        backed_up += 1
    return backup_dir if backed_up else None, backed_up


def write_payload(code_dir):
    backup_dir, backed_up = backup_existing(code_dir, PAYLOAD)
    for rel, blob in PAYLOAD.items():
        target = code_dir / rel
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(decode_blob(blob))
    return backup_dir, backed_up


def validate_hashes(base_dir, rel_paths):
    mismatches = []
    for rel in rel_paths:
        target = base_dir / rel
        actual = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        expected = HASHES[rel]
        if actual != expected:
            mismatches.append((rel, expected, actual))
    if mismatches:
        lines = ['hash validation failed:']
        lines.extend(f'  {rel} expected={exp} actual={act}' for rel, exp, act in mismatches)
        raise SystemExit('\n'.join(lines))


def compile_python(code_dir):
    for rel in PAYLOAD:
        if not rel.endswith('.py'):
            continue
        source = (code_dir / rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
        compile(source, str(code_dir / rel), 'exec')


def mirror_to_root(code_dir):
    root_dir = code_dir.parent if code_dir.name == 'code' else code_dir.parent
    if root_dir == code_dir:
        return False, root_dir
    has_mirror = (root_dir / 'agent_ppo').exists() or (root_dir / 'kaiwu.json').exists()
    if not has_mirror:
        return False, root_dir
    for rel in MIRROR_SUBSET:
        src = code_dir / rel
        dst = root_dir / rel
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    validate_hashes(root_dir, MIRROR_SUBSET)
    return True, root_dir


def main():
    code_dir = detect_code_dir()
    backup_dir, backed_up = write_payload(code_dir)
    validate_hashes(code_dir, PAYLOAD)
    compile_python(code_dir)
    mirrored, root_dir = mirror_to_root(code_dir)
    print('R5.6.2 long-train patch applied')
    print('code_dir:', code_dir)
    print('files:', len(PAYLOAD), 'mirrored:', len(MIRROR_SUBSET) if mirrored else 0)
    print('backup:', backup_dir if backup_dir else 'none', 'backed_up:', backed_up)
    print('root_dir:', root_dir if mirrored else 'not mirrored')
    print('next_1= code patch applied; no local env overrides are needed for cluster training')
    print('next_2= quick cloud-IDE smoke: python3 train_test.py 2>&1 | tee r5_6_2_longtrain_smoke.log')
    print('next_3= if smoke is clean, go to platform Version Management and generate a version')
    print('next_4= create a new cluster-training task with distributed training mode')
    print('next_5= keep parallel environment count at 32')
    print('next_6= set pretrained model to the final checkpoint generated from the completed R5-6 task')
    print('next_7= keep opponent/eval config from code: opponent_agent=selfplay, eval_opponent_type=common_ai')
    print('next_8= start long training from the platform task page')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
